summary: ```# Introduction to New Features in Marvelous Designer 2025.0 - User Interface Updates Welcome to the new feature introduction video of Marvelous Designer 2025. In this version, we have updated the user interface and increased the response speed. ## Current Window Composition First, let's take a look at the current window composition. ### Main Menu At the top, you can find the main menu. Here, you can classify the function or tool. ### 3D and 2D Windows On the left side of the screen is the **3D window**. Here, you can edit and adjust the 3D costume. On the right side is the **2D window**. Here, you can edit the 2D version. ### Object Window On the top right is the **object window**. Here, you can select various elements in the 3D window, such as plants, stickers, names, buttons, etc. ### Property Editor Below is the **property editor**. In the property editor, you can adjust the properties of the selected items. ### Animation Editor - Click on the arrow at the bottom to open the animation editor. - Click on the button to move the animation editor window freely. - Click on the magnification icon to expand the animation editor to full screen. - Click on the small button to return the animation editor to its previous size. - Click on the icon to close the window and return it to its original position. - Click on the button to close the window. These attached windows can be folded, separated, or rearranged. ### Layout Options In the lower right corner, you can switch to the main window layout or select only the 3D window or 2D window. Click **Reset** to reset the page to the default layout. Now, in the 2025 version, you can manage all windows at the bottom of the window bar. You can choose whether to display these windows. If you need to open a window, you can go to the menu below to select the corresponding option. ## Interface Layout Options In this menu, there is an **interface layout option** that allows you to export and switch between different page layout options. The export page layout can be switched in the top row of the layout option bar. ### Updated Main Menu Next, let's take a look at the updated main menu. Two new main menus have been added. The third menu is to set the default layout to the user's definition. There is a high-quality layout and style layout option in the layout tab. The layout type is the same as the previous version. You can click the corresponding icon in the 3D window to open or cancel the application. ### Connect Tab The **Everywhere function** is set to the Connect tab. You can change the layout settings here. The layer has different options. For example, we will choose the default layout. To right-click and select the **New Layout**, we will open the new layout window. The new layout window shows our default assets. When you switch to the **Connects assets** tabs, you will be able to directly use these commercial assets. ### CLOSET Tab Click on the **CLOSET tab** to manage or open the files you have uploaded to the CLOSET platform. Click on the old drawing box to return to the previous drawing box window. Click on the new drawing box to return to the new drawing box window. ## Tool Icons and Management The tool icon has become larger and easier to select and use. The tool icon has been integrated into the 3D toolbox, and you do not need to change the window to use it. ### Object Window Enhancements Since the 2025 version, materials other than fabric can also be managed in the object window. In the **scene box**, you can view various components in the current project scene. You can adjust the detail of the fabric in the plant column. ### New Group System The new **group system** allows you to manage multiple fabrics. You can insert, configure, and manage the attached images added to the clothing in the sticker column. In the button column, you can manage and adjust the application settings. You can use the button type style on clothes and manage and adjust the button type style in the button column. You can also manage and adjust the attached styles applied to the clothes in the attached section. ### Accessing the Shop Interface Click on the icon window in the upper left corner of the label section to open the shop interface corresponding to the label section, including the default assets and Connect shop. ## Conclusion For more information, please refer to our handbook page or watch our other new feature introduction videos. ```
